results.title: Mirae Asset Sekuritas assesses global pressures still weighing on the market
results.body: Mirae Asset Sekuritas says global sentiment continues to weigh on Indonesia’s market, noting that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 1.33% to 6,589 amid a net foreign outflow of Rp748 billion. The pressure was most evident on banking stocks BBCA and BBRI, while foreign investors accumulated commodity‑linked shares such as ANTM, AADI, CUAN and PTBA. The firm cites macro factors including the US 10‑year Treasury yield near 5%, the ECB rate at 2.5%, high oil prices, the rupiah at roughly Rp17,547 per USD and a 10‑year SBN yield of 7.11% as limiting the transmission of global yields to the domestic market. Despite these headwinds, consumer confidence rose to 118.5 in August and Mirae Asset recommends a selective portfolio focused on strong fundamentals and solid cash flow.

results.title: Antam reports H1-2026 revenue of Rp 62.71 trillion, with gold sales exceeding Rp 50 trillion
results.body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, Antam, reported first‑half 2026 revenue of Rp 62.71 trillion and net profit of Rp 6.91 trillion, with gold sales generating Rp 50.39 trillion, representing the majority of its earnings. Gold volume reached about 18.1 tonnes, while nickel production was 7.78 million wet metric tons and sales 6.77 million wmt. The company also highlighted its bauxite value‑chain integration, operating the Chemical Grade Alumina facility through PT Indonesia Chemical Alumina (300 k t/yr) and holding a 40 % stake in Smelter Grade Alumina Mempawah (1 M t/yr). Antam is advancing a precious‑metal manufacturing plant in Gresik with a planned capacity of 30 tonnes per year, now in pre‑construction. As of H1‑2026, total assets stood at Rp 61.27 trillion, equity at Rp 38.53 trillion and cash and equivalents at Rp 9.23 trillion.

results.title: Analysts Project Continued Strength for Metal Miners ANTM, INCO, and TINS Through Late 2026
results.body: KB Valbury Sekuritas and Phintraco Sekuritas maintain a positive outlook for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, and PT Timah Tbk for the remainder of 2026, citing solid first-half performance and supportive commodity prices. ANTM posted revenue of Rp62.7 trillion in the first half of 2026, up 6.3% year-on-year, with KB Valbury setting a target price of Rp4,000 per share on the back of a gold price rebound. INCO recorded revenue of US$543 million, a 27.3% increase, and KB Valbury assigns a Rp5,600 target price driven by rising global nickel prices and the completion of its Electric Furnace 3 rebuild in June 2026. TINS achieved 41% of its annual tin ore production target in the first half, and Phintraco highlights a global tin supply deficit of around 3% and strong demand from electronics and AI sectors as key catalysts for the second half.

results.title: UBS Sekuritas Leads Net Buying of PT Aneka Tambang Tbk Shares, While JP Morgan Issues Bullish Outlook
results.body: UBS Sekuritas led the net‑buy activity for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) on 9 September 2026, purchasing shares at an average price of Rp3,159 and generating a net purchase value of over Rp95 billion, while CGS International Sekuritas followed with a net buy of more than Rp75 billion at an average price of Rp3,170. The heavy buying helped lift ANTM’s share price 3.91 % to Rp3,200 at the close on 9 September and a further 4 % to Rp3,330 by midday on 10 September. The activity coincided with a rebound in global spot gold to US$4,424 per troy ounce and a bullish note from JP Morgan’s Asia Pacific Equity Research, which expects an earnings upgrade for ANTM based on favorable nickel market dynamics and its strong gold‑refining business.

results.title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst highlights expansion prospects and buy recommendations for PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Petrosea Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk.
results.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Abida Massi Armand reviews the overseas mining expansion of PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Petrosea Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk. PT Bumi Resources Tbk, via its subsidiary Bumi Resources Australia Pty Ltd, completed the acquisition of 100% of Loyal Metals Ltd for Rp 1,004,742,244,136.50 (AUD 79,069,731.75); PT Petrosea Tbk finalized a binding offer for Tolu Minerals Limited, issuing convertible notes worth AUS $23.75 million; PT United Tractors Tbk is exploring mineral asset acquisitions in Australia; and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk is targeting gold production in the Middle East. The analyst recommends buying PT Aneka Tambang Tbk with a target price of Rp 4,900 and PT United Tractors Tbk with a target price of Rp 30,600, noting strong free cash flow and diversification benefits. He cautions that integration risks, possible overpaying and regulatory hurdles may delay profit contributions for two to three years after the deals.

results.title: Foreign investors show early signs of tactical re-entry into Indonesian equities, with analysts highlighting big banks and select sectors.
results.body: Foreign investors are showing early signs of tactical re-entry into Indonesian stocks, with net buying concentrated in large-cap banks during the week of August 31 to September 4, 2026. In that period, foreign net purchases reached Rp1.85–2.3 trillion, led by PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk, and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk, which together recorded over Rp3.19 trillion of net foreign buying in the regular market. LQ45 outflows have declined sharply from over Rp15 trillion in June to under Rp2 trillion in August, and the number of LQ45 stocks with outflows fell to 27 from 36 in June. Analysts caution this is not yet a structural trend reversal, as year-to-date foreign outflows remain around US$3.94 billion, and sustainability depends on Federal Reserve policy, rupiah stability, and earnings growth. Potential rotation targets include commodity stocks ANTM, AMMN, and INCO, as well as consumer and industrial names TLKM, ASII, INDF, and UNTR, with advisors recommending accumulation on weakness.

results.title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk Shares at Rp 3,120, Analysts Forecast Rise to Rp 4,700
results.body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, Indonesia's state‑owned mining company, saw its shares close at Rp 3,120 on September 4, 2026, down 0.95%. Analyst Hasan Barakwan of Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia maintains a buy rating with a target price of Rp 4,700, citing strong first‑half earnings and a robust nickel business. The company posted revenue of Rp 62.7 trillion, EBITDA of Rp 8.98 trillion, and net profit of Rp 6.39 trillion in the first semester, with nickel sales up 71% quarter‑on‑quarter. Projected 2026 revenue could reach Rp 130.53 trillion and net profit Rp 9.26 trillion, driven by continued nickel volume and price gains.

results.title: Antam Gold Buyback Price Increases by Rp133,000 to Rp2.493 million per Gram on Sep 6
results.body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price rose by Rp133,000 per gram to Rp2,493,000 per gram on Sunday, 6 September 2026. The increase represents a 5.64% year‑to‑date gain from the start‑of‑year level of Rp2,360,000 per gram. Despite the rise, the price remains Rp496,000 (about 16.59%) below the all‑time high of Rp2,989,000 per gram, limiting profit potential for sellers who bought near the peak. The buyback price, set by PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, is a key indicator for investors, and under PMK No. 34/PMK.10/2017 gold sales above Rp10 million to the company are subject to a 1.5% or 3% withholding tax depending on the seller’s NPWP status.

results.title: Maybank Sekuritas Maintains Buy Rating and Rp 4,700 Target Price for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk as Nickel Business Drives Growth
results.body: Maybank Sekuritas maintained a buy recommendation and a Rp 4,700 target price for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, citing strengthening nickel contributions that offset a normalization in gold earnings. In the first half of 2026, the company posted a 36% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rp 6.39 trillion, driven by a 420% surge in ferronickel sales volume and a 50% rise in nickel ore average selling price to US$81.6 per wet metric ton. The broker projects 2026 revenue of Rp 130.53 trillion and net profit of Rp 9.26 trillion, with nickel volume and price gains expected to counterbalance a slowdown in precious metals trading.

results.title: Stock Market Gains, Simas Syariah Unggulan Mutual Fund Posts 10.28% Return in August
results.body: Sinarmas Asset Management’s Simas Syariah Unggulan fund posted a 10.28% month‑on‑month return in August 2026, far above the average reksadana saham return of 3.60% and the IHSG index gain of 4.64% in the same period. The fund’s outperformance was driven by basic materials and consumer non‑cyclical sector strength and its top holdings of Bank Jabar Banten Syariah (18.57%), Aneka Tambang (18%), Dharma Satya Nusantara (15.01%), Archi Indonesia (12.20%) and Japfa Comfeed Indonesia (11.49%). Batavia Prosperindo Asset Management’s Batavia Dana Saham Syariah fund delivered a 6.04% month‑on‑month return, supported by energy, basic materials and infrastructure exposure, with its largest positions in Aneka Tambang (6.47%), Alamtri Resources Indonesia (5.10%), Kalbe Farma (4.29%), Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur (4.11%) and Indofood Sukses Makmur (3.73%). Both managers outlined sector‑focused strategies for the next period, with Batavia planning to increase energy exposure and Sinarmas intending to use artificial intelligence to enhance asset allocation.

results.title: IHSG and Asian Exchanges Cheerful This Morning
results.body: The Jakarta Stock Exchange (IHSG) opened higher on Friday, September 4, 2026, gaining 27.8 points (0.42%) to 6,695 as Asian markets such as KOSDAQ, Hang Seng, KOSPI, Shenzhen Composite, CSI 300, Straits Times, Shanghai Composite, NIKKEI 225 and TW Weighted Index also rose in green zones. The rally was supported by a net foreign purchase of Rp1.07 trillion, a strong rupiah at Rp17,660 per USD, and bullish technical levels with the index breaking resistance at 6,650 and targeting 6,724 while holding support near 6,550. Brokers highlighted several stocks as top picks: BRI Danareksa recommended BBCA, LSIP and ARCI; Phintraco listed JPFA, PANI, CPIN, ANTM and ARCI; CGS International suggested ADMR, AADI, ADRO, SMGR, BMRI and MDKA; and Panin Sekuritas favored BDMN, AALI and SMDR. Analysts noted that continued foreign buying, commodity price gains and a dovish Fed outlook could sustain the market, though short‑term profit‑taking ahead of the weekend remains a risk.

results.title: Foreign Investors Net Buy Rp1.07 Trillion, Lifting IHSG 1.09% as Jumbo Banks Lead Inflows
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net buy of Rp1.07 trillion in the Indonesian stock market on Thursday, September 3, 2026, propelling the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) up 1.09% to 6,667.89. The four jumbo banks — Bank Mandiri, Bank Central Asia, Bank Negara Indonesia, and Bank Rakyat Indonesia — accounted for approximately Rp801 billion, or 75% of total foreign net buying. Other notable foreign purchases included Charoen Pokphand Indonesia, Aneka Tambang, Alamtri Resources Indonesia, and Chandra Asri Pacific. On the sell side, Buana Lintas Lautan, Bumi Resources, and Petrosea topped the net sell list.

results.title: Batavia Dana Saham Syariah posts a 6.04% return in August, highlighting data center infrastructure stocks
results.body: The article reports that Batavia Dana Saham Syariah, a Sharia‑compliant equity fund managed by Batavia Prosperindo Asset Management, delivered a 6.04% month‑on‑month return in August 2026. This outperformed the average mutual‑fund equity return of 3.60% for the same period and was driven by the fund’s largest active weight in the infrastructure sector, particularly stocks linked to data‑center development. The portfolio’s top holdings included Aneka Tambang (6.47%), Alamtri Resources Indonesia (5.10%), Kalbe Farma (4.29%), Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur (4.11%) and Indofood Sukses Makmur (3.73%). The manager also indicated plans to increase exposure to the energy sector, citing an El‑Niño view as a catalyst for future adjustments.

results.title: IHSG May Face Correction on Friday (4/9) – Projections and Stock Recommendations
results.body: The Indonesian composite index (IHSG) closed Thursday, 3 September 2026, at 6,667.89, up 1.09%, and analysts forecast a possible short‑term correction on Friday, 4 September. Analysts see support near 6,655 and resistance around 6,714, while another analyst expects the index to test 6,705 with resistance at 6,700 and support at 6,600. The report recommends buying ASII within 5,125–5,200, BMRI at 4,510–4,590, CDIA with entry 660–690 and target 735–765 (stop loss 630), and SMRA with entry 316–322 and target 336–344 (stop loss 310). It also highlights JPFA, PANI, CPIN, ANTM and ARCI as stocks to watch in the current market environment. Investors are cautioned about profit‑taking risk and are advised to monitor U.S. non‑farm payroll data and the upcoming OPEC+ meeting that could affect sentiment.

results.title: First-Half 2026 Net Profit Rises Sharply for Indonesian BUMNs, Analysts Cite Danantara's Restructuring and Issue Stock Recommendations
results.body: First-half 2026 net profit surged across major Indonesian state-owned enterprises, with PT Semen Indonesia Tbk posting Rp 228.25 billion (up 408.9% YoY), PT Aneka Tambang Tbk earning Rp 6.91 trillion (up 34% YoY), PT Timah Tbk - whose profit is attributed to the parent entity's owners - reporting Rp 2.71 trillion, 169% of its Rp 1.61 trillion target, and PT Bank Tabungan Tbk achieving Rp 2.40 trillion (up 40.8% YoY), while PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk, PT PP Tbk and PT Adhi Karya Tbk also posted double-digit profit growth. Analysts recommend buying BMRI on weakness with a target of Rp 5,800, accumulating PT Timah Tbk at Rp 5,500, accumulating INCO at Rp 5,000-6,000, targeting PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk at Rp 4,500, and taking short-term trading positions in PT Timah Tbk between Rp 4,600-4,720. They attribute much of the earnings boost to sector-specific factors such as commodity price recoveries and demand rebounds, while noting Danantara's capital injections into PT Garuda Indonesia Tbk and PT Krakatau Steel Tbk as broader restructuring catalysts. Risks remain from rupiah exchange-rate movements, global market conditions, commodity volatility, and the execution of Danantara's restructuring of BUMN Karya.

results.title: Foreign investors net buy Rp1 trillion, collectively snapping up PT Bank Mandiri Tbk and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk shares
results.body: Foreign investors net bought about Rp1 trillion in Indonesian equities on Thursday, with state‑owned banks PT Bank Mandiri Tbk and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk leading the inflows. The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed up 1.09% at 6,667.89 points on a trading volume of 40.79 billion shares and total transaction value of Rp18.64 trillion. PT Bank Mandiri Tbk recorded the largest net foreign purchase of Rp471.38 billion (foreign transaction value Rp1.04 trillion), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk ranked seventh with a net foreign buy of Rp87.40 billion (total foreign transaction Rp176.42 billion), while PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk, PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk, PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk, PT Astra International Tbk and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk each posted net foreign buys ranging from Rp57.20 billion to Rp207.10 billion. The inflows came amid positive domestic sentiment after the Bank Indonesia governor’s emphasis on economic stability, despite lingering global geopolitical tensions.

results.title: Mandiri Sekuritas projects Indonesia's IHSG could reach 7,470 by end‑2026, citing four catalysts
results.body: Mandiri Sekuritas released a broker report on 3 September 2026 projecting the Indonesian composite index (IHSG) to finish 2026 between 5,920 and 7,470, with the index at 6,667 on the day, up 1.09% (72.11 points). Under a base‑case scenario the IHSG is expected at 6,810 with earnings‑per‑share growth of 46%, while a bearish case sees 5,920 and EPS growth of 39%. The report also forecasts the IDX80 to move to 107.2 in the base case, 122.1 in a bullish case and 87.9 in a bearish case, and attributes the outlook to four catalysts: structural gains in precious‑metal, mineral‑downstream and energy sectors; a pro‑people fiscal policy supporting earnings; higher cost of capital prompting more selective investment; and government‑driven industry restructuring encouraging sector rotation. Its top‑10 stock picks are AMMN, ANTM, ARCI, INCO, MEDC, GGRM, AMRT, MIKA, ISAT and BBCA, reflecting expectations that gold, copper, nickel, oil & gas, healthcare, tobacco, telecom and financials will benefit.

results.title: ANTM reports semester I‑2026 net profit of Rp 6.91 trillion
results.body: ANTM reported its semester I‑2026 financial results, posting a net profit of Rp 6.91 trillion. The profit rose 34% year‑on‑year, with EBITDA reaching Rp 9.62 trillion (up 35%), gross profit Rp 10.85 trillion (up 32%) and operating profit Rp 8.44 trillion (up 38%). Other income increased 41% to Rp 559.37 billion, net profit per share climbed to Rp 265.85 (up 36%), while total assets grew 27% to Rp 61.27 trillion, equity to Rp 38.53 trillion and cash and cash equivalents to Rp 9.23 trillion. CEO Untung Budiharto said the results provide a basis for strengthening beyond operational excellence to achieve sustainable growth.

results.title: Antam (ANTM) Posts Q2 2026 Net Profit of Rp 3 Trillion, Analyst Issues Recommendation and Target Price
results.body: PT Antam Tbk reported Q2 2026 net profit of Rp 3 trillion, down 12.5% quarter-on-quarter but up 16.2% year-on-year, exceeding BRI Danareksa Sekuritas estimates by 7%. First-half net profit reached Rp 6.4 trillion, a 36% year-on-year increase representing 69.7% of the full-year forecast, while revenue grew 6.3% to Rp 62.7 trillion. Nickel revenue surged 32.4% year-on-year with average selling price rising 18.7% quarter-on-quarter to US$80 per ton, lifting nickel net profit margin to 54.5%. Gold revenue rose only 1.4% despite a 13.6% volume increase to 9.6 tons, as gold ASP fell 9.2% quarter-on-quarter to US$4,753 per troy ounce, compressing gold net profit margin to 4.4%. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Andhika Audrey issued a recommendation and target price for ANTM shares based on these results.

results.title: IHSG predicted to consolidate with four stock trading recommendations for September 2, 2026
results.body: Phintraco Sekuritas predicts the IHSG will consolidate on Wednesday after closing at 6,599.9 on Tuesday, with a key range of 6,535-6,635 unless it holds above 6,635 to test 6,705. MNC Sekuritas sees further upside potential toward 6,615-6,666 and recommends four stocks for trading: ANTM, BBCA, ESSA, and HRTA. Supporting the outlook, domestic inflation rose to 3.19% year-on-year in August while the manufacturing PMI contracted to 49.8, though the trade balance posted a $0.13 billion surplus in July. The rupiah weakened 0.12% to 17,744 per dollar amid broader Asian market weakness and rising oil prices on US-Iran tensions.
